newsitem.title: LEBANON: Audi up on Beirut market. [CORRECTED 16:24 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Audi up on Beirut market. [CORRECTED 16:24 GMT]

text.p: Recently-listed bank shares kept up strong performances on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday but turnover fell sharply.
Shares of Banque Audi rose to $15.625 on Wednesday from Tuesday's $15.5 on turnover of 50,000 compared to 100,000 a day earlier and 10,000 on Monday when they began trading.
One block trade of 83,200 Audi shares changed hands on the floor at $15.625 while three blocks totalling 291,270 shares traded at $15.5 off the bourse floor.

Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, which began trading on December 30, remained unchanged from Tuesday's $12.375 (Corrects from gained two percent to $12.625) on turnover of 2,000 shares against Tuesday's 1,197. BLC has risen steadily since it began trading at $11.25.
Solidere A shares rose to $10.75 from $10.625 on Tuesday and B shares fell to $11 from $11.125.
Turnover on the BSE in all traded shares fell sharply to 99,739 from Tuesday's 140,884 for a value of $1,123,859 against $1,994,414 a day earlier.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index fell 0.01 percent to 917.41 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.32 percent to 81.76.
